atom:entry.atom:title: Pix DICT: refund monitoring default
atom:entry.atom:summary: [neutral] So what for merchants: Check refund integrations that rely on implicit monitoring defaults. DICT 2.13.0 changes the default value of Refund MonitorAccount to false. Review integrations for implicit defaults. Who: Pix participants and refund engineering teams. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.bcb.gov.br/content/estabilidadefinanceira/pix/changelog.html

atom:entry.atom:title: Pix DICT: recovery API clarifications
atom:entry.atom:summary: [neutral] So what for merchants: Review recovery API changes before implementation; a candidate release is not a deadline. The September release candidate adds FundsRecoveryId path-parameter documentation and clarifies refund-request restrictions. A release candidate is not a compliance deadline. Who: Pix participants and fraud operations. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.bcb.gov.br/content/estabilidadefinanceira/pix/changelog.html
